```artifact
Feature: Admin and Patient Information Management

  As an admin, I want to update doctor, lab, and chemist information in the system
  As a patient, I want to update my personal details and create future appointments

Scenario Outline: Updating Information
  Given I am logged into the system as an admin or patient
  When I navigate to the update information section
  Then I should be able to update the relevant information

Examples:
  | Role   | Information Type | Status  | Preconditions                                  | Inputs                                  | Expected Outcome                                  |
  | Admin  | Doctor           | Updated | Admin is logged in, doctor exists in system       | Doctor's new details                      | Doctor's details updated in system             |
  | Admin  | Lab/Chemist      | Updated | Admin is logged in, lab/chemist exists in system | Lab/chemist new details                    | Lab/chemist details updated in system             |
  | Patient | Personal Details  | Updated | Patient is logged in, personal details exist   | Personal details new                      | Personal details updated in system             |
  | Patient | Appointment       | Created | Patient is logged in, appointment does not exist | Appointment date and details                 | Appointment created and visible in system             |

Scenario Outline: Error Handling
  Given I am logged into the system as an admin or patient
  When I navigate to the update information section with invalid input
  Then I should receive an error message

Examples:
  | Role   | Information Type | Status  | Preconditions                                  | Inputs                                  | Expected Outcome                                  |
  | Admin  | Doctor           | Error   | Admin is logged in, doctor does not exist       | Invalid doctor details                     | Error message displayed                           |
  | Admin  | Lab/Chemist      | Error   | Admin is logged in, lab/chemist does not exist | Invalid lab/chemist details                | Error message displayed                           |
  | Patient | Personal Details  | Error   | Patient is logged in, personal details do not exist | Invalid personal details                    | Error message displayed                           |
  | Patient | Appointment       | Error   | Patient is logged in, appointment exists in system | Invalid appointment details                    | Error message displayed                           |

Scenario Outline: Boundary Values
  Given I am logged into the system as an admin or patient
  When I update information with boundary values
  Then I should be able to update the information within limits

Examples:
  | Role   | Information Type | Status  | Preconditions                                  | Inputs                                  | Expected Outcome                                  |
  | Admin  | Doctor           | Boundary | Admin is logged in, doctor exists in system       | Doctor's details at maximum length           | Doctor's details updated within length limit |
  | Admin  | Lab/Chemist      | Boundary | Admin is logged in, lab/chemist exists in system | Lab/chemist details at maximum length           | Lab/chemist details updated within length limit |
  | Patient | Personal Details  | Boundary | Patient is logged in, personal details exist   | Personal details at maximum length           | Personal details updated within length limit |
  | Patient | Appointment       | Boundary | Patient is logged in, appointment exists in system | Appointment date at maximum length           | Appointment date updated within length limit |
